lcc_original: 那人給他的妻子起名叫夏娃【6】，因爲她是衆生之母。
notes: H0120 (אָדָם): UNV renders as proper name 亞當 (Adam); LCC uses common noun 那人 (the man) — same Hebrew word, tag attaches to 那人
SN tag for 夏娃 (H02332) placed immediately after 夏娃 and before LCC's footnote marker 【6】, preserving original text structure
All other tokens align one-to-one with no rephrasing; LCC 衆 vs UNV 眾 is a font/variant difference only
